title: pilosella callimorpha
intro: Pilosella callimorpha, commonly known as the false fox-glove or common mouse-ear, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits, including wound healing and the alleviation of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella callimorpha include its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off infections, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids.
